## Grafica para el 01 (sin Trigger Telegram)
Lo llama la tool enviar_grafica. SQL → Chart.js → POST QuickChart → sendPhoto.

1. Importa y mapea Postgres + Telegram.
2. Publica/activa este flujo.
3. En el 01, tool enviar_grafica: elige este workflow y refresca inputs.
4. Config.quickchartUrl: interno `http://quickchart:80/chart` o publico `https://demo-quickchart.hiti0l.easypanel.host/chart`.
5. chat.id lo manda el 01; tipo embudo_mes | reservas_dia; periodo YYYY-MM.

No pongas nombres ni telefonos en la grafica.

parameters.query:
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d)::date AS start_day,
         (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::date AS end_day
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(start_day, end_day - 1, interval '1 day')::date AS dia
  FROM bounds
)
SELECT
  to_char(d.dia, 'DD/MM') AS label,
  COUNT(l.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'concreto')::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN first_touch f
  ON (f.first_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date = d.dia
LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
GROUP BY d.dia
ORDER BY d.dia;

WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d) AS start_at,
         date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
)
SELECT
  to_char(b.start_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
  COUNT(l.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'concreto')::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'no_respondio')::int AS no_respondieron,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'en_proceso')::int AS en_proceso,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'concreto') / NULLIF(COUNT(l.id), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_reservaciones
FROM bounds b
LEFT JOIN first_touch f
  ON f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at
LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
GROUP BY b.start_at;
